why: Two fixes to the OFFLINE evidence corpus and its producer, both Tier-1 by path. (1) scripts/ops/build_strategy_evidence.py now refuses to overwrite a `measured` record with a failed run. (2) scripts/research/regime_debt_matrix.py computes `fidelity`/`omitted_levers` from the argv that actually runs instead of asserting them from a membership set, and the 13 committed records whose CLAIM was wrong are corrected in place -- two keys only, no measured number moved, no harness re-run. No config/, src/, deploy/ or order-path file is touched and nothing that decides what trades is changed; both corrections are strictly in the conservative direction. scripts/ops/**, scripts/research/**, tests/**, comms/** and docs/** are all on TIER1_SURFACE.
